sn23.22:1.1: Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Rādho Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Nirodhadhammo nirodhadhammoti || || Katamo nu kho bhante nirodhadhammo ti || || Rūpaṃ kho Rādha nirodhadhammo || vedanā || saññā || saṅkhārā nirodhadhammo || viññāṇaṃ nirodhadhammo || || Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || Vaggo dutiyo || ||
sn23.22:2.0: Uddānam || || Māro ca Māradhammo ca || || Aniccehi pare duve || Dukkhehi ca dve vuttā || Anattehi tatheva ca || || Khaya-Vaya-Samudayaṃ || Nirodhadhammena dvādasāti || ||
